import pathlib, os
pr=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544646/attempts/cb2a11620c414603a21132bf1f3c6a84/system/state/workspace/programs')
pr.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 2, 8)}
    # The non-background color marks the pattern to copy. In each task instance
    # there is one such color; 0-valued cells matching the marker are copies.
    color = next(iter(colors))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    pattern = {(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells}
    ph = max(r for r, c in pattern) + 1
    pw = max(c for r, c in pattern) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-ph+1):
        for c in range(w-pw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in pattern):
                for dr, dc in pattern:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''
(pr/'task-af555978.py').write_text(code)
